# Aman Chand

> Full-stack software developer from Nepal with 2+ years of experience building web and mobile products. Specializing in Node.js, React, React Native, Android, iOS, and web scraping.

Born 2005-11-05 in Nepal. Alumnus of Tribhuvan University. Currently Lead Software Developer at Dopamine Confectionery. Speaks English, Nepali, and Hindi. Available for freelance and contract work.

- Site: https://amanchand.com.np
- Email: amanchandinc@gmail.com
